title: Sunset feature — traffic resume & monitoring slate (Jun 2027)
body:
Purpose:
This slate captures a conservative, observable approach to resume traffic to a service after a scheduled sunset/deprecation change. Goal is to resume traffic in controlled steps, verify business and system signals, and provide explicit rollback gates. Use this when removing legacy code paths, switching model variants, or turning off a long-lived feature flag that could impact inference latency/cost or correctness.

Scope and assumptions:
- Applies to host-side changes and model variant swaps that can affect latency, error profiles, or token economics.
- We assume primary telemetry (p95 latency, error-rate, token-cost) is available for the feature route and baseline.
- Feature toggle is reversible (flag or routing layer) and has a one-click rollback path documented below.

High-level plan (3 stages):
1) STAGE A — DRY-RUN / ANNOUNCE (pre-resume) — owners: Sofia, SRE on-call
   - Freeze non-essential merges for the route (60m window).
   - Run smoke harness on canary traffic (0% production) for 30m.
   - Post Slack announcement: #releases + #prod-watch with schedule and rollback anchor.

2) STAGE B — GRADUAL RESUME (0% -> 100% by steps) — owners: release-eng + SRE
   - Step increments: 1%, 5%, 15%, 50%, 100%. Hold 10–20m at each step (configurable per traffic shape).
   - At each hold evaluate signals (see Signals & Gates).
   - If all gates pass, continue to next step; else pause and escalate.

3) STAGE C — STABILIZE & CLEANUP (post-100%) — owners: product + metrics
   - Keep high-sampling telemetry for 2h (full traces + example prompts).
   - Schedule retrospective note and update deprecation doc.

Calendar (example timeline for a 3-hour window):
- T-60m: Preflight checklist complete, Slack heads-up
- T-30m: Final smoke harness run
- T0: Toggle routing rule to allow 1%
- T+20m: Validate signals, bump to 5%
- T+40m: Validate, bump to 15%
- T+75m: Validate, bump to 50%
- T+105m: Validate, bump to 100%
- T+180m: Postmortem note draft, close runway

Signals & Gates (explicit pass/fail thresholds):
- Errors: 5xx rate for feature route <= baseline * 1.5 OR absolute increase < 0.3% (whichever is smaller).
- Latency: p95 <= baseline p95 + 120ms. If p95 increase > 120ms, STOP and investigate.
- Token-cost: average cost-per-request delta <= +15%.
- Quality: deterministic regression tests for the top-10 prompts must pass (no semantic drop > configured threshold).
- Side-effects: downstream queue length, cache miss rate, DB tail latency should not exceed baseline by more than 20%.

Escalation and rollback criteria (immediate):
- Any uncaught crash or service outage affecting >0.5% of global traffic.
- Error rate > 3x baseline OR sustained >1% absolute increase for 10m.
- Latency p95 increase > 300ms over baseline for 5m.
- Failed deterministic QA for critical prompt sets at any gate.

Rollback mechanics (one-click path):
- Feature-flag toggle: /ops/feature-toggle revert <flag_name> --to previous
- Routing layer rollback: update route-weight for legacy variant = 100% (UI: Console > Routing > <route> > weights)
- If rollback from infra change required: run: infra/rollback-snapshot --tag <pre-deploy-snapshot> (SRE only)
- Post-rollback: run the rollback-playbook checklist, capture artifacts, and notify #incidents

Preflight checklist (must be green before T-60m):
- [ ] Owner assigned and in Slack watch channel
- [ ] Runbook link posted to release thread in #releases
- [ ] Canary smoke tests pass locally and in staging
- [ ] Baseline telemetry window collected (last 24h) and baseline artifact attached
- [ ] Backup routing snapshot saved (route-snapshot-id: REINF-route-<ts>)
- [ ] Ops bucketing / quotas verified for increased downstream load
- [ ] Alert thresholds reviewed and temporarily lowered for sensitive metrics

Hold checklist (for each step):
- [ ] Compare real-time metrics to baseline: errors, p95, CPU/GPU utilization, token-cost
- [ ] Run top-10 prompt sanity suite (automated) — attach results
- [ ] Verify logs for new exception patterns (search: "UnexpectedModelState")
- [ ] Confirm storage/backing services have normal backpressure levels

Smoke test matrix (minimal):
- Path: /generate -> 3 short prompts (sanity) -> check response shape, no None fields
- Path: /chat -> multi-turn 4-step conversation (context retention) -> check token continuity
- Path: /embeddings -> run 20-sample batch -> verify embedding dims and variance
- Perf: small synthetic load (100rps for 60s) to check tail latencies

Communication snippets (copy-paste):
- Preflight to #releases: "Planned resume for routed-sunset at 2027-06-15T14:00Z. Owners: SofiaM, SRE-oncall. Will progress 1/5/15/50/100% with 10–20m holds. Rollback anchor: route-snapshot REINF-route-20270615-02. Slack watch: #prod-watch"
- Pause message: "PAUSING resume at <percent> due to signal: <metric> > threshold. Investigating — paging SRE and release-eng. Do not modify route weights during investigation."
- Rollback announcement: "Rolling back routed-sunset to legacy variant (100%) due to signal: <reason>. Followup: incident thread <jira-id>"

Post-release artifacts to collect (attach to release thread):
- Full telemetry snapshot (1h pre, during, 2h post)
- Top-10 prompt QA results and diffs
- Route snapshots and config checksums
- Smoke harness logs and synthetic load reports

Draft release notes (copy-edit before publish):
- Headline: "Sunset guards and route resume for legacy inference path"
- Body: "We resumed production traffic for the decommissioned legacy inference route in a staged rollout on 2027-06-15. The change moves traffic to the consolidated model serving path which improves maintainability and reduces per-token cost. The rollout followed the Release Engineering Gradual Resume slate: incremental traffic steps with explicit telemetry gates. No user-facing regressions were detected; performance p95 improved by ~20ms on average across key routes. We will keep elevated telemetry sampling for 48h and finalize the deprecation artifact after the observation window."

Owner and rotation notes:
- Primary: Sofia Martinez (release-eng lead)
- Secondary: Ethan Park (SRE)
- Tertiary/esc: Jada Nguyen (product), Omar Castillo (infra)
- On-call: follow SRE rota. If owner unreachable, SRE can execute rollback.

Open questions / TODOs:
- Decide on exact hold time for 50% -> 100% for high concurrency regions (APAC).
- Add automated quicksanity job that runs immediately after each bump (ticket: REINF-2125).
- Confirm whether billing analytics needs special sampling for token-cost validation.

Notes to the reader:
- This is a working slate intended to be pragmatic and conservative. Keep language short and actionable in Slack messages. If this run is high-risk, expand holds and add manual QA gates.

Change log:
- 2027-06-01: Draft created (Sofia)
- 2027-06-07: Added explicit cost gate and rollback commands (Ethan)
- 2027-06-15: Updated thresholds and calendar times after dry-run
